stem: A sensor cable appears damaged during a routine check. Technician I is not authorized for electrical repair. What is the strongest response?
choices: Document the asset/location, follow any out-of-service step in procedure and escalate for qualified repair
Open the device and repair the wiring
Tape the cable and continue without documentation
rationale: Document the asset/location, follow any out-of-service step in procedure and escalate for qualified repair. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
